scenes.sub: Allah tells us He has made the Quran easy to remember.
scenes.translation: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

scenes.h1: Make learning it easy for your child
scenes.sub: Our job is to make learning it easy for your child.
One teacher, one child, 30 minutes, at a time that suits your family.
Book a free trial class at nurulhudaacademy.org
